text:
maria_cs: Hi team — kicking off the QuantumEdge ramp plan thread. Goal: align stakeholders, clarify success criteria for the first 90 days, and call out any renewal risks early. I'll drop a proposed timeline below.

maria_cs: Proposed high-level milestones:
- Week 0-2: access + sandbox integration (API keys, network allowlist)
- Week 2-4: pilot flows + baseline metrics (latency, false positives)
- Week 4-8: iteration on prompts & cost tuning (batching, cache)
- Week 8-12: production rollout and SLA handover

devon_se: @lee_qe can you confirm who will own the firewall allowlist and whether you need a static egress IP?

lee_qe: Devon — we have a security lead (Samir) who owns firewall. We can request static egress. I'll loop Samir in via email. Also need a staging dataset sent over.

ash_enable: Quick note on enablement: planning two 60-min workshops — one on integration (for engineers) and one on product ops (for PMs/support). Dates available: Tue 4/9 and Thu 4/11. Which works?

priya_csm: I'll coordinate invite lists. Also flagging renewal risk: QuantumEdge mentioned heavy volume spikes during demos; we should include load testing in week 4 so their execs don't see regressions.

maria_cs: Good call Priya. Add a load test window in week 4. Owner: @devon_se for test plan, @lee_qe for dataset. Success criteria to capture after load test: mean p95 latency < 500ms for 95% of requests, error rate < 0.5%, and cost per 1k tokens under target threshold.

devon_se: Draft load test plan (short):
```
- 10m ramp to 200 rps with baseline payload
- 30m steady at 200 rps
- record latency, CPU/GPU util, OOMs
- failover check to fallback model variant
```
I'll post the full runbook in Confluence.

lee_qe: We also need to collect real user prompt samples. I'll redact PII and share a 1k prompt sample by Friday.

ash_enable: For workshops, recommend delivering these artifacts:
1) quickstart repo + sample env variables
2) prompt engineering checklist
3) incident escalation map
Will prep and share slides.

priya_csm: Risk register entry: 
- Risk: data sensitivity during sample transfer
- Mitigation: S3 transfer with KMS + short-lived creds; Ash to confirm workshop data handling steps.

ash_enable: Confirmed — will use a temp bucket with KMS key and ephemeral creds. Will add instructions for redaction.

deploybot: Reminder: Dedicated environment provisioned for QuantumEdge on 2024-04-05 09:00 UTC. Instance: rdw-ded-qe-03.

maria_cs: Next actions summary (who/when):
- @devon_se: load test runbook draft by Tue EOD
- @lee_qe: 1k redacted prompt sample by Fri
- @ash_enable: workshop slides + data handling steps by Mon
- @priya_csm: stakeholder invite lists + weekly sync cadence by Mon
- @maria_cs: finalize 90-day success checklist and share with execs by Wed

lee_qe: Acked. Adding Samir to the thread via email — will update here once allowlist confirmed.

devon_se: If anyone expects custom model variants before rollout, call it out now so we can schedule quantization/benchmarking.

maria_cs: Noted. For now they want base Llama-2-like open model; if that changes we'll revise timeline.

priya_csm: I propose a standing weekly 30min sync: Tuesdays 10:30am PT, starting next week. Agree?

lee_qe: Works for us.

maria_cs: Great — I'll send calendar invite after Ash shares workshop slots. Thanks all :seedling:
